title: Tables 1 and 2 and the whole per-area census are hardcoded literals, not computed from data — 'empirical_response_census.json' contains no empiricism

goal.text: Every number in omission-a traces to a deterministic computation over real NWB/TFR data, with the computing script identified.
goal.falsifier: Closed when each of Table 1, Table 2, the GLMM fixed effects, and every figure percentage is regenerated by a script that reads outputs/ or D:/workspace/data/ and writes its own receipt, with the hardcoded census file deleted or renamed to mark it non-empirical.

notes: RECEIPT: scripts/archive_oneoff/compute_empirical_census_and_power.py lines 46-57 define unit_census_per_area as a hardcoded Python dict literal. Those literals are exactly Table 1 of the manuscript (V1 Total 1084 / O+ 12 ... PFC Total 1116 / O+ 104). Lines 71-82 define lfp_sig_channels_per_area as a hardcoded dict literal; those are exactly Table 2 (V1 1152/622/714/841/288 ... PFC 1056/686/760/877/181).

RECEIPT: the script opens artifacts/data/all_21_sessions_audit.json but uses it ONLY for len(sessions_audit). total_units_corpus = 8597 and total_channels_corpus = 8736 are also hardcoded literals (lines 32-33). No array, CSV, or NWB file is read for any reported count.

RECEIPT: line 45 comment states the construction rule explicitly — 'Per-Area Distributions (incorporating hierarchical gradient: sensory V1/V2 rich in S++/S+, prefrontal FEF/PFC rich in O+)'. The V1->PFC O+ gradient was authored, not measured. This is why Table 1 yields Spearman rho = 0.988 vs hierarchy rank while the real classification output yields rho = -0.297.
RECEIPT: lines 111-131 hardcode lfp_power_pct_change and spk_fr_pct_change as STRING literals ('+42.8%', '+245.8%'). These are not even numeric types.
RECEIPT: the script's only 'verification' (lines 60-66) sums its own hardcoded dict and prints the total. That is the 'sum checks out' receipt that propagated as confirmation.

PROPAGATION: the script writes artifacts/data/empirical_response_census.json — a file named 'empirical' that contains no empirical content. It is consumed by 9 scripts, including build_manuscript_draft_final.py, build_biorxiv_ready_manuscript.py, build_markdown_analysis_reports.py, generate_killer_figure.py and polish_figures_4_5.py. Tables 1-2, Figure 4, Figure 5, Figure 8, the Abstract and the Results text all inherit from it.

SELF-CORRECTION: earlier this session I reported that all four reported CIs 'reproduce exactly as Clopper-Pearson' and treated that as confirming node analysis-clopper-pearson-confidence-intervals. The arithmetic reproduction was correct but the inference was wrong. scripts/archive_oneoff/derive_real_computed_stats.py — titled 'Pipeline Real Computation Audit & Data Receipt Generator' and documented as deriving 'true exact stats from empirical files' — reads empirical_response_census.json and computes Clopper-Pearson intervals AROUND THE HARDCODED COUNTS. The CIs are real intervals around synthetic numbers. Verifying the interval arithmetic verifies nothing about the data.

GLMM: the headline fixed effects (Logit coef = 1.1241, SE = 0.1048, OR = 3.08, Wald z = 10.726, p = 7.25e-27) appear only as hardcoded strings inside presentation scripts (biorxiv_polish_pass.py, calibrate_computational_tone.py, calibrate_native_voice.py, build_8_figure_master_architecture.py, build_clean_publication_figures.py). No script in scripts/ or jnwb/ fits a binomial mixed model that produces them. No convergence receipt exists because no fit occurred.

REAL DATA EXISTS AND IS SUFFICIENT: outputs/classification/grand_unit_table_shuffle_sso.csv holds a real 6,655-unit table (4.2 MB) and IS read by derive_real_computed_stats.py section 1. D:/workspace/data/tfr_arrays/ holds 948 real memory-mappable TFR arrays (~1.7 TB) with shape (trials, 128 channels, 99 freqs, 500 samples) covering 17 sessions x 12 conditions x 12 area labels — V1, V2, V3, V3a, V3d, V4, MT, MST, TEO, FST, FEF, PFC. Note V3, V3a and V3d are SEPARATE array labels here, whereas the manuscript collapses them to 'V3a-d-v' via map_area_canonical(); the V3 alpha/beta exception Hamm reports is therefore resolvable from these arrays but is averaged away by the manuscript's own area mapping.

SCOPE OF WHAT REMAINS TRUE: the 21-session corpus audit, the NWB topology, the area ordering, the paradigm timing, and the figure/asset pipeline are unaffected by this finding. What is unsupported is the per-area census, the band-channel counts, the derived CIs, the GLMM fixed effects, and every percentage computed from them.
issues: The integrity edits applied earlier this session (omission-a-2026-manuscript-integrity-pass.docx) made the caption percentages agree with Tables 1-2. Those tables are now known to be non-empirical, so that pass improved internal consistency around unsupported numbers. The structural fix (orphaned Results block), the impossible-p-value removal, the FWER/FDR fix, the multiplicity demotion, the 531 ms timing fix and the author-placeholder removal all remain valid independent of the census question.
Node analysis-clopper-pearson-confidence-intervals is status 'confirmed' but its inputs are the hardcoded counts. It should be demoted.
Node context-manuscript-draft-final and context-checkpoint-seal-20260726 both record the census as verified; both inherit the same unsupported inputs.

The naming of both the script ('compute_empirical_census_and_power') and its output ('empirical_response_census.json') actively concealed the issue from every downstream consumer and from prior review passes, including yesterday's scientific review and figure audit.
Directly violates the machine-wide doctrine 'No silent synthetic science' — synthetic values were emitted with no synthetic marker in the filename, the JSON, the tables, or the figures.
plan: Do not submit, circulate, or further polish omission-a until the census is regenerated from real data.
Regenerate the single-unit census from grand_unit_table_shuffle_sso.csv (6,655 real units) and/or the real 21-session unit tables, with the population explicitly named in the manuscript.

Compute per-channel band power relative to baseline for the five canonical bands from D:/workspace/data/tfr_arrays/, keeping V3/V3a/V3d unmerged, to obtain real Table 2 counts and to test the V3 alpha/beta exception.
Fit the binomial-logit GLMM for real, on the real unit table, and emit a convergence receipt.
Rename artifacts/data/empirical_response_census.json to mark it non-empirical rather than deleting it (Conservation), and add a guard so no build script consumes it.

verification.receipt: Source file read directly at scripts/archive_oneoff/compute_empirical_census_and_power.py; dict literals at lines 46-57 and 71-82 compared cell-by-cell against the DOCX tables extracted this session — exact match on all 70 Table 1 cells and all 50 Table 2 cells. Consumer list obtained by grep for 'empirical_response_census' across scripts/ and jnwb/. GLMM constant traced by grep for '3.08', '10.726' and '7.25' across all scripts: presentation-layer string literals only, no fitting call.

links.reasoning: Node presents the CIs as empirical verification. They are exact intervals computed around hardcoded counts, so they verify arithmetic only. Supersedes my own earlier 'confirms' edge from omission_a_manuscript_integrity_pass_20260728.
That node recorded a 'confirms' edge to the Clopper-Pearson node on the strength of interval reproduction. The reproduction was real; the conclusion that it evidenced empiricism was wrong.
Records the single-unit and LFP censuses as empirical results; both trace to the hardcoded dict.
Seal reports a verified manuscript and census. The census it verified was never computed from data.
Node specifies a GLMM whose fixed effects were never fit; the reported OR/z/p exist only as presentation-layer string constants.
Figure 6's empirical-TFR guardrail was the one place this class of substitution was already caught and defended against; the same guardrail was absent for the census tables.
